free_tier_limits: 100 requests/month; personal-use license; real-time flights; HTTPS included; advanced features such as historical flights and routes require a paid plan
rate_limits: Monthly quota of 100 requests on the Free plan; no separate per-second limit is prominently published; HTTPS is included
resolution_notes: pricing.free_tier_limits: auditor correct. Official pricing (https://aviationstack.com/pricing, crawled 2026-08-08) lists Free plan features as 100 Requests, Personal License, Full Aviation Data, Real-Time Flights, and HTTPS Encryption; Historical Flights / Airline Routes appear only on Basic+. The original “HTTP only (HTTPS requires paid)” claim is outdated. rate_limits: auditor correct for the same reason — Free includes HTTPS; limits are monthly request quotas (100 Free; higher on paid), with no separate per-second cap published on pricing/FAQ (https://aviationstack.com/pricing, https://aviationstack.com/faq).
